photos.author: Owen Jones, The Grammar of Ornament (1856)
photos.label: Ornament plate study
photos.note: Look for parallel mirror lines through the repeating figures. The Commons page has conflicting plate metadata, so regional attribution is omitted. A finite print is approximate evidence.

photos.author: Dmharvey
photos.label: Running-bond brickwork
photos.note: Rows are offset by half a brick. Look for perpendicular mirrors in the ideal bond; real brick textures vary. Finite images give approximate evidence.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.

photos.author: Dmharvey
photos.label: Municipal House floor, Prague
photos.note: Look for half-turns and mirror lines in one direction. In the other direction, a flip needs a shift. The source photograph was digitally enhanced. Finite images give approximate evidence.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.

photos.author: Dmharvey
photos.label: Pavement near the Great Synagogue, Budapest
photos.note: Compare both directions of the herringbone bonds. The source labels the ideal design pgg. The photograph was digitally enhanced. Finite images give approximate evidence.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.

photos.author: Dmharvey
photos.label: Wall tiles at the Alhambra, Granada
photos.note: Look for three tiles cycling around a common corner. Compare the colors as well as the shapes. The source classification describes the repeating motif in this digitally enhanced photograph.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.

photos.author: Owen Jones, The Grammar of Ornament (1856)
photos.label: Egyptian ornament print
photos.note: Compare the fine stripes when testing a glide. Simplifying the zigzag can introduce extra mirrors. This historical print provides approximate evidence.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.

photos.author: Owen Jones, The Grammar of Ornament (1856)
photos.label: Persian ornament print
photos.note: Inspect the quarter-turn centers and look for horizontal, vertical and diagonal mirror directions. Finite images give approximate evidence.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.

photos.author: Owen Jones, The Grammar of Ornament (1856)
photos.label: Chinese ornament print
photos.note: Look for quarter-turn centers and offset diagonal mirrors. Compare corresponding colors as well as outlines. Finite images give approximate evidence.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.

photos.author: Owen Jones, The Grammar of Ornament (1856)
photos.label: Persian rosette ornament print
photos.note: Look for sixth-turn centers and mirrors through the rosettes. Finite images give approximate evidence.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.

photos.author: Owen Jones, The Grammar of Ornament (1856)
photos.label: Historic ornament print
photos.note: Look for a half-turn exchanging motifs, then test whether a mirror would reverse their details. Finite images give approximate evidence.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.

photos.author: Owen Jones, The Grammar of Ornament (1856)
photos.label: Byzantine ornament print
photos.note: Follow the rotations and mirrored regions around a hexagon in this tiling. Finite images give approximate evidence.
photos.changes: Resized if needed and re-encoded; no additional crop.
